verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents first-party framework SDKs: Next.js with server- and client-side utilities, Astro with session validation and route protection, plus React, TanStack Start and Laravel integrations. That covers framework-level route protection. Nothing in the pack shows middleware that verifies sessions at the edge, so the reviewer's concern holds and the verdict stays partial rather than full. Missing for 10: documented Next.js middleware for route protection, edge-runtime session verification, independent or hands-on corroboration.
